brief: A client-side Fabric mod that shows more of what the server already tells you: huds, menus and chat tools. It sits on top of FOECollab, observes and never plays for you. The logo has to feel at home next to it: flat, minimal, rounded tiles.
criteria: Success: reads as a fishing hook at 16 px, works in one colour, fits the rounded-tile look of the mod's own screens.

concepts.name: Hook in a box
concepts.idea: A fish hook, with its eye, cut into a rounded tile: the tackle box is the tile.
rationale: The tile is the same rounded square as the mod's own screens, so the icon looks like part of the mod.
Cyan to mint is the mod's accent colour; the hook carries it, the tile stays quiet.
A heavier small-size cut keeps the hook readable at 16 px for the Mod Menu list and the favicon.

recommendation: Use the full symbol from 64 px up and the small-size cut below that. Wordmark in lowercase, exactly tacklebox, to match the mod name.
